The most apparent pattern in everything that has been happening for the past few hundered years is the increase of the gap between the rich and the poor. More poor people and less rich people increase day by day. The elevator operator got replaced by something cheaper, who made the money? Elevator companies. Now people who used to do simple tasks that ai can now do more efficently will get replaced. Who will make the money? Ai companies. What I have seen in my industry is that Ai made coding easier. Now a single senior dev can do the job of 10 juniors. Now when new jobs come to the market, they'll pay much worse than what the juniors were going to make as developers. Ai companies will make more money, the poor will get poorer. Every system in this world has been designed for this one thing. You can't change that, if I were to become a rich person, then the systems in place will force many other people to become poor. The simplest example in my industry is hiring offshore developers in poor Asian countries. Taking away the money from a dev in western countries and giving it to a someone else who would do it for less. But the pattern is still there. The company makes more money, the employee is making less. Anyways the world will wake up to these monopolies someday
